skills.name: idear
skills.description: Use when a rough software, tool, automation, or AI-product idea needs product clarification, feasibility evidence, comparison with existing solutions, or a development handoff before implementation.
triggers: Clarify a rough software, tool, automation, or AI-product idea before coding.
Assess whether an idea is feasible using evidence.
Compare existing products, open-source projects, APIs, or technical approaches.
Prepare a confirmed idea for a development handoff.
